construction_strategy: Create one independent axis-aligned body from the accepted minimum and maximum corners with BlockBody.Create.
semantic_selection_plan: Re-enumerate all bodies after creation; require exactly one body and match it by bounding box and volume before naming.
failure_checkpoints: validate geometry contract and output paths before packaging
verify body count, bounding box, volume, faces, edges, and name before save
output_policy: Use distinct run-owned model and report paths and refuse overwrite.
